surface_resolution.reuse_rule: Extend/consume shared owners; do not create a second mobile shell merely because the swarm surface is named prometeo-mobile.

reuse_ledger.evidence: Prometeo mobile truth identifies V5 manifested bytes as the explicit Served byte authority. README documents the single global tactile control, favorites, corner anchoring, page-scoped change loop and canonical root-host result links.
reuse_ledger.mobile_rule: Do not fork a second global/mobile control. Mobile-specific behavior must remain responsive behavior of the single host unless a later exact acceptance contract proves otherwise.

reuse_ledger.evidence: A concrete shared Capture module exists, while V5 Served behavior already includes page-scoped Notas/Cambios, text capture, private attachment intake and Anywhere Notes v3 behavior.
reuse_ledger.authority_note: The exact Served classification comes from the V5 manifest/digest, not from the candidate/ directory name. The standalone shared/capture module is a donor/component ref, not a second product authority.

reuse_ledger.evidence: The candidate bridge defines the shared path from page/surface human intent to preserve-first planner input, deterministic/deduplicated opportunity identity, sanitized RETURN feed and Universal Host reopen URL.
constraints: raw/private human intent is not emitted into public coordination output
surface-only targets do not invent a page_id
bridge output grants no Human Accepted/Served/global promotion authority

reuse_ledger.evidence: The registry already defines stable surface_id prometeo-mobile, root binding, planner/steward pointers and privacy/authority boundaries. Its route entry is older than the later truth return and remains CANDIDATE; it must be reconciled, not treated as a reason to invent a second route.
reuse_ledger.truth_delta: Later Prometeo mobile truth resolves the logical surface through the root Universal Host while still finding no dedicated catalog page_id.

reuse_ledger.evidence: Prompt/Context archaeology maps current functional successors to Agent Runtime compilation plus bounded Working Set/context-receipt contracts. Context Foundry v2 explicitly encodes EXISTS != PARTICIPATES, privacy inheritance, contradiction fail-closed, deterministic selection and reopenability.
reuse_ledger.known_gap: Automatic exact per-task Working Set materialization was NOT_PROVEN by the archaeology return; existing kernel/allocator/history owners already cover the gap frontier, so mobile must not create a duplicate Context Foundry/Prompt OS.

reuse_ledger.evidence: Worker Fabric archaeology verifies the reusable current descendant as universal cognitive worker kernel + role-fluid allocator + durable claim/run/return lifecycle, including generator/evaluator/promoter separation and append-only recovery.
reuse_ledger.mobile_rule: Use shared typed roles and durable lifecycle; do not create a mobile-specific dispatcher/collector/evaluator/integrator runtime.

reuse_ledger.evidence: Catalog preserves a recovered Psicoanálisis PageKit source and the repository has shared class component/runtime families. These are reusable interaction/content patterns, but no inspected authority makes PageKit the owner of Prometeo mobile shell/navigation.
reuse_ledger.reuse_boundary: Borrow proven class/page component behavior only where a concrete mobile surface need exists; preserve Universal Host ownership and avoid wholesale shell transplant.

non_obvious_findings.finding: The highest-value mobile reuse path is composition over the existing Universal Host and shared coordination/runtime owners. A dedicated mobile shell would duplicate the strongest Served authority and create a second global-control source of truth.

The candidate surface registry still marks prometeo-mobile public_route UNRESOLVED, while the later truth return resolves the logical surface through the root Universal Host. This is a freshness/authority-granularity delta to reconcile, not evidence for a new route or page_id.

A Served V5 source can physically live under candidate/, and reusable PageKit/Capture/Context Foundry bytes can exist without owning the Prometeo product. Exact lifecycle authority and owner contracts outrank directory names or component existence.
Prompt OS/Context Foundry and Worker Fabric should be consumed through their verified current descendants and shared modules, not revived as parallel subsystems from historical vocabulary.

preserve_first_rules: single Universal Host remains the product-level shell owner
surface_id prometeo-mobile does not imply a catalog page_id
candidate bridge/registry/kernel do not self-promote through reuse
PageKit is a donor pattern, not a replacement shell
raw/private Capture content stays outside public coordination artifacts
reuse must reduce duplicate owners rather than multiply them

deduplication.decision: No new opportunity emitted. The mobile planner is the next missing same-surface dependency; local integration already exists and should activate only after its declared returns exist.
